artifact.note: The preserved Issue #44 fresh training-ready checkpoint (completed_episodes=0). It uses seeded Task 2 input columns and remains the exact Issue #46 untrained starting artifact.

corrected_migration_artifact.note: Issue #85 versioned fresh migration artifact. Its Task 2-only input columns are zero, preserving the inherited five Q-values for every suffix. It has no training or evaluation evidence.

parent.freeze_integration_note: PR #72 squash-merged into main as freeze_merge_commit. freeze_source_commit remains the exact reviewed parent tree the successor was migrated from; the two differ only because a squash merge does not preserve the source branch's own commits.

rule: copy the parent's 8 input-layer columns verbatim into the successor's first 8 input columns
zero the remaining 13 input columns so Task 2-only features do not change inherited Q-values before learning
copy both hidden layers (64x64) verbatim; their shape is unchanged
copy the parent's 5 output rows and biases verbatim into the successor's first 5 output rows
zero the BOMB output row's weights and set its bias to -1.0, a fixed conservative estimate
initialize the target network from the migrated online network
reset the optimizer and replay buffer to fresh/empty; neither is compatible with the parent's
